name: GTG-50027
akas: Likely a Bamako-based independent consultant contracted to Mali's state intelligence service (Agence Nationale de la Sécurité d'État, ANSE)
brief: A single Claude subscriber — likely a Bamako-based independent consultant working for Mali's state intelligence service (ANSE) — used Claude to build "Lakana 360," a population-scale domestic-surveillance platform monitoring roughly 25 million SIM cards across all three of Mali's national mobile operators (call records, text messages, and voice-call capture). The actor directed Claude to design the system so its LLM-generated intelligence-dossier component bypassed Mali's own legal requirement for a court order before disclosing surveillance records — "the warrant requirement was removed, at the operator's request, from the component that writes an LLM-generated intelligence dossier." Anthropic cites US State Department/Human Rights Watch documentation of Malian security-service detention of opposition figures as context. Anthropic
ttpMd:
